Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidentiary significance of petrified palm trees, focusing on permineralization and groundwater rather than the diagnostic paleoecological signal. Palm fossils indicate that palms once grew there, implying a past warm/tropical climate, not merely “more water.” This led to selecting A instead of the correct C.
